name: Hindustan Organic Chemicals Limited
about: Hindustan Organic Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells bulk industrial chemicals and chemical intermediates in India. The company offers phenol, acetone, and hydrogen peroxide chemical products used in phenol formaldehyde resins, bisphenol-A, solvents, bleaching, and environmental applications. It also provides engineering plastic polytetrafluoroethylene. The company serves the drugs and pharmaceuticals, paints, resins and laminates, dyes and dyes intermediates, rubber chemicals, textiles, agrochemicals and pesticides, and plywood industries. Hindustan Organic Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Ernakulam, India.
